title: Half-cent amounts round the wrong way
statement:
Our accounting policy rounds half-cent amounts half away from zero, and the docstring of ledgerlite.money.to_cents says the same, but:

    >>> to_cents(Decimal('2.665'))
    Decimal('2.66')      # expected 2.67
    >>> to_cents('0.005')
    Decimal('0.00')      # expected 0.01

Negative amounts should mirror positive ones (-2.665 -> -2.67). format_money() and allocate() round through to_cents and show the same discrepancy on invoices. Please fix the rounding.
